products.title: Blue Summit Supplies Visitor Badge Log-Book with Duplicate Record, 250 Pack

description.html: Easily identify visitors to your school or office Keeping track of visitors to your building can be a hassle, but with our Visitor Badge Log Book you can easily keep track of who visits, while keeping their information secure. Log book includes 250 stickers that guests can wear on clothing. Stickers include lines for name, company, date, and arrival time. Inside the book, visitor information is protected by pages that do not allow guests to see other visitor names, inside a cover for added protection. Our Visitor Badge Log Book also includes duplicate copies of each badge for your records and tracking. Top bound binding allows you to easily tear out previously used sticker sheets and log pages that have been filled. Great for any building to track visitors, regardless of their visit.
